policies.title: Belizean e-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Belize's current adult e-passport service requires direct evidence that the applicant is a Belizean citizen.
conditions: Applies to a Belizean citizen holding a valid standard Belize e-passport; special documents and ordinary lawful border controls remain outside the classification.

policies.title: Venezuelan passport and citizen entry
policies.summary: Venezuela's national passport identifies Venezuelans abroad, while Article 50 permits Venezuelans to enter without prior authorization.
conditions: Applies to a Venezuelan citizen holding a valid standard national passport; identity, document and other lawful border controls remain.

policies.title: Cuban current ordinary passport and entry
policies.summary: Cuba's 2026 Migration Law reserves the ordinary passport to Cuban citizens and regulates their entry with that passport or an equivalent document.
conditions: Applies to a Cuban citizen holding a valid ordinary Cuban passport; the law's identity, security and other express migration limitations remain.

policies.title: Dominica national ePassport and entry
policies.summary: Dominica's citizen ePassport rule and constitutional movement protection establish the national standard-passport home relationship.
conditions: Applies to a Dominican citizen holding a valid national ePassport; emergency, collective, seaman and other special documents and lawful controls remain.

policies.title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines ordinary passport and citizen entry
policies.summary: The national-security service distinguishes the ordinary passport and serves diaspora citizens, while the Attorney General confirms citizens' entry right.
conditions: Applies to a citizen holding a valid blue ordinary passport; official, diplomatic and other special documents and lawful controls remain.

policies.title: Burundian ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Burundi's official ordinary-passport service expressly limits that standard travel document to persons of Burundian nationality.
conditions: Applies to a Burundian national holding a valid ordinary passport; service, diplomatic and regional documents and lawful controls remain outside the classification.

policies.title: Central African national passport and return
policies.summary: The Central African Republic requires nationality proof for its biometric passport and provides nationals without a valid passport a return-only laissez-passer.
conditions: Applies to a Central African national holding a valid standard biometric passport; identity checks and other lawful controls remain.

policies.title: Egyptian ordinary passport and citizen return
policies.summary: Egyptian nationality is the basis for the ordinary passport, and the Constitution protects citizens from being prohibited from returning.
conditions: Applies to an Egyptian citizen holding a valid ordinary machine-readable passport; identity and other lawful border controls remain.

policies.title: Eritrean national passport and repatriation
policies.summary: Eritrea's Embassy requires national identity evidence for its passport and provides a documented repatriation route for return to Eritrea.
conditions: Applies to an Eritrean national holding a valid standard Eritrean passport; identity, document and other lawful border controls remain.

policies.title: Gabonese passport and return
policies.summary: Gabon provides a nationality-backed emergency passport substitute for return, and its 2026 operational record confirms reception of returning Gabonese nationals.
conditions: Applies to a Gabonese national holding a valid ordinary passport; identity and other lawful border controls remain.

policies.title: Guinean national return
policies.summary: Guinea's official facilitation regulation removes a return visa for its nationals and requires a nationality-certified emergency document valid for readmission.
conditions: Applies to a Guinean national holding a valid standard passport; identity, document, safety and other lawful border controls remain.

policies.title: Mozambican normal passport and return
policies.summary: Mozambique issues normal passports through diaspora consular services and operationally receives returning Mozambican citizens at its border.
conditions: Applies to a Mozambican citizen holding a valid normal passport; identity, document and other lawful border controls remain.

unresolved.reason: No current official source directly ties Chad's standard ordinary passport to Chadian citizenship or supplies a current general citizen-entry or return rule; stale and lookalike mission material is not promoted.
The passport law establishes the document class, but no current official source supplies a general ordinary-passport citizen-entry or return route sufficient for promotion.
The official mission publishes an ordinary-passport fee but not a citizenship eligibility rule or a current national entry or return route.

No current directly attributable DPRK official source establishes both a standard national-passport basis and current citizen entry or return treatment; the 1999 state report is not treated as current evidence.

Palestinian passport and identity services establish document administration, but split registry, border, permit and crossing control prevents normalization of a territory-wide ordinary-passport home-entry rule.
